company.name: HiGuests
company.shortDescription: Property management company that manages the short-term rental of properties in Dubai, Barcelona, Mumbai, Dominican Republic and Australia
company.description:
HiGuests family started when two friends from Barcelona realized the huge amount of hassle arranging all the logistics around Airbnb. HiGuests family works HARD and PASSIONATE GLOBALY to take care of your home as it was ours. Our customers will not realize anything about the process, and we will ensure your Guests enjoy from the best stay.

HiGuests is a property management company that manages the short-term rental of properties through various portals including Airbnb, HomeAway, and Booking.com.

HiGuests has developed best in class TECHNOLOGY to manage operations, allow hosts to monitor the evolution of its property and guests to maximize their travel experience. APP for Host, Guest and our own PMS (Property Management System) is essential in our business model.

HiGuests' in-depth knowledge of the short-term rental market allows PROPERTY ONWNERS get maximum revenue potential thank to  our centralized profile mangement team (profile creation, account/revenue management/inbox management. Instant updated information throw Host App.

HiGuests offers a bespoke service to all our GUESTS to ensure they have a most enjoyable stay thanks to our local teams (check in/out, cleaning, laundry, maintenance, 24/7 guest services). App for Guest ensure 5 star review.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,242,173 to $10,635,877, a 4.74x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 54 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 42 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
